title: Break-even + sales forecast
headline: Base-case growth is 6.6% in FY2027E against the 7.0% goal, and the extra revenue does not repay the ฿560 million a year of net-new spend by FY2028E.

charts.title: Extra revenue: needed vs base (60.0% kept)

series.name: Needed to repay ฿240m of tactics: ฿400m

charts.title: Total revenue growth by scenario vs 7.0% goal

callouts.label: Base case: F1 revenue test, 7.0% both years

body.note: Tactics: the ฿240m that earns modelled revenue, repaid in 1.2 years; the other ฿320m earns none. Pass-through assumed 50%.

notes: We add 560 million baht a year of net-new marketing. Only 60 percent of extra revenue is kept, so we need 933 million more a year. The tactics are the 240 million that earns modelled revenue; they need 400 million and repay in 1.2 years. The full 560 million a year does not. In 2028 it needs 67 percent of any gain to reach CPN's revenue; we assumed 50. The tactics need only 29 percent. Base-case growth is 6.6 percent in 2027 and 6.9 in 2028, short of 7. Only the optimistic case passes, by definition. Our fifth speaker covers expenses and profit.
